answer: Mechanism, stated concretely: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. The required words slot into it cleanly: ocean embodies the transparency that makes every pattern visible, ember mirrors the compute burned to admit each new identity, and anchor stands for the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
